name: 28777 · Spruce Pine, NC
findings: ZIP 28777 (Spruce Pine) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28777 (Spruce Pine) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28777 (Spruce Pine) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
